Confirmed: leakage LEVEL rises with K (dose-control: at matched 400 total positives + matched 1:1 ratio, K=8 > K=1 for every held-out persona; β(K)=+0.30, p=0.008, survives comedian-drop). UNRESOLVED: the tilt question — full-panel β(K×min_dist)=−0.81, p=0.011 → drop comedian → β=−2.14, p=0.51 (SE inflates ~10×). Cause: held-out panel had 7 personas at min-dist 0.008–0.09 and only comedian at 0.18–0.24, with a dead gap at 0.05–0.15; K=8 was a single octet (the full pool). Leave-one-persona-out + DFBETAS confirm comedian-only leverage.

**Distance-spanning panel IS feasible from a natural pool (no synthesis needed).** A 111-persona pool exists: `scripts/run_100_persona_leakage.py` defines `ORIGINAL_PERSONAS` (11) + `PERSONAS_100` (100), inline as `{name: {prompt, category, related_to}}`, 11 diversity categories (professional_peer, opposite, hierarchical, intersectional, cultural_variant, fictional_exemplar, tone_variant, domain_adjacent, unrelated_baseline, ...). Saved centroids at `eval_results/single_token_100_persona/centroids/centroids_layer{10,15,20,25}.pt` (each `[111, 3584]`, persona order = `{**ORIGINAL_PERSONAS, **PERSONAS_100}`). A 111×111 pairwise cosine-distance matrix is NOT precomputed but trivially derived from the centroids.

**Geometry computed today (layer-20 cosine, 111 personas):** pairwise distances span 0.003–0.396, median 0.129 (vs the #405 20-pool's 0.268 ceiling, median 0.055). Band populations (pairwise): [0.10–0.15) 24.1%, [0.15–0.20) 18.7%, [0.20–0.25) 11.7%, [0.25–0.30) 5.5%, [0.30+) 3.6%. The manifold has a real far tail.

**CRITICAL design caveat for the planner — very-far band needs deliberate joint selection, not random subsets.** Simulating min-dist of every held-out persona to a *random* 8-persona trained set (300 draws): avg per min-dist band = near[0–0.05] 48.8, mid[0.05–0.10] 35.4, [0.10–0.15] 13.4, far[0.15–0.20] 3.1, very-far[0.20–0.25] 1.3, [0.25–0.30] 0.9. Held-out with min-dist≥0.20 averages just 2.3 (range 0–11) for a random 8-set. So a random K-subset design does NOT reliably give 4–6 personas in the very-far band. To populate near/mid/far/very-far with several personas each, the planner must JOINTLY design the source pool (e.g. confined to a manifold region, or a pool whose subsets keep a far tail held-out) and the held-out panel, then VALIDATE band occupancy over the ACTUAL planned subsets via this exact min-dist sim — do not assume the pairwise distribution carries over to min-dist-to-set. This interacts with the "multiple distinct K=8 subsets" goal (varied source sets shift each held-out persona's min-distance per cell): power-simulate band occupancy across the real subset list before committing GPU.
